components.name: LyricsDisplay
components.description: 逐行歌词展示，支持当前行高亮、点击跳转与双语翻译。
components.example:
<LyricsDisplay
  currentTime={5}
  isPlaying={false}
  lyrics={[
    { time: 0, text: '前奏', translation: 'Intro' },
    { time: 5, text: '等待星辰对齐', translation: 'Wait for the stars to align' },
  ]}
/>

components.name: AudioVisualizer
components.description: 音频频谱可视化，支持圆形与柱状两种模式。
components.example:
<AudioVisualizer
  frequencyData={new Uint8Array(32).fill(80)}
  emotion="calm"
  isPlaying
  size={180}
  mode="circular"
/>

components.name: CoverFlow
components.description: 3D 封面流：拖拽惯性、键盘导航、封面倒影与高光，支持受控/非受控选中。
components.example:
<CoverFlow
  tracks={[
    { id: '1', title: '星轨', artist: 'YYC³', cover: '/covers/1.jpg' },
    { id: '2', title: '夜航', artist: 'YYC³', cover: '/covers/2.jpg' },
    { id: '3', title: '回声', artist: 'YYC³' },
  ]}
  defaultSelectedIndex={1}
  onSelect={(track, index) => console.log(index, track.title)}
/>
